title: Live copilot research resolves the exact company name 'KPIT Technologies' to the wrong listed entity (Birlasoft) via a stale former-name coincidence
repro: Live invoke: vy.py invoke copilot 'research KPIT Technologies' --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b against candidate sidecar :52354 (rc1-round-4-cand, seed data rc1-round-4-data-rc1-battery-14). The research tool built its brief for symbol BSOFT.NS (Birlasoft Limited). GET /resolve?q=KPIT%20Technologies returns needs_disambiguation:true with KPITTECH (KPIT Technologies Limited, confidence 1.0) listed FIRST and BSOFT (Birlasoft Limited, former_name 'KPIT', confidence 1.0) listed second -- the agent-tool-side resolution picked the second, wrong, tied candidate instead of the literal name match.
